question: Who of the following was awarded by the Sangeet Natak Akademi for contribution to Bharatnatyam dance style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radha Sridhar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Radha Sridhar** was awarded by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** for her significant contribution to the **Bharatnatyam** dance style.
 
• She is renowned for her dedication and excellence in promoting and preserving the traditional art form of Bharatnatyam.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, and it recognizes outstanding artists in these fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi** was established in **1952 **by the Government of India to promote and preserve the performing arts of India.
 
• It is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Culture** and serves as the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country.
 
• The Akademi awards are considered among the highest national recognitions given to practicing artists.
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, and sophisticated hand and facial gestures.
 
• Radha Sridhar has been a pivotal figure in the Bharatnatyam community, inspiring many young dancers through her performances and teaching.
